title: Lesson 1: Latency, Throughput & Queueing Theory — js-tools
desc: The first lesson of the System Design roadmap. Latency versus throughput and why optimising one harms the other, the orders of magnitude from L1 cache to an intercontinental round trip, why the mean is a deceitful number, Little's Law, and the non-linear wall that makes a server at 70% utilisation already fragile.
